comparison.objective: Place a phone, watch, and earbuds case on their matching positions of a three-in-one charger.
comparison.physical_skill: Align three devices to different charging surfaces, including handling a flexible watch band, without moving the stand.
comparison.success_condition: All devices remain released and charging with indicators observed for five seconds while the stand stays within pose limits.
comparison.reason: Multi-device placement and functional charging verification do not test hammer/mandrel coordination, fracture mechanics, or recovery of released tangs.
